claim: Black-Litterman weights are stable under noisy views

data.process: 10 assets, one-factor covariance, true means = equilibrium, views = truth + N(0, 0.1^2)

metric: mean L1 distance between successive weights; mean max |weight|
verdict_rule: supports if BL turnover - MV turnover < -2 SE (paired)
summary: turnover per rebalance 0.83 (BL) vs 1.13 (MV) in L1 at gross 1; largest weight 0.27 vs 0.26
